verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own Crawl API gets data from many pages in a single request, which is a real multi-item operation built into the product. It is limited to following links from one starting URL rather than general bulk operations over an arbitrary set of items. missing for 10: documented batch operations over arbitrary item lists (e.g., batch scrape/extract of many URLs or bulk session actions), bulk job status/limits documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk runs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The Crawl API allows you to crawl websites and get data from multiple pages in a single request.
